scope: Real native permission denial/grant and WKWebView retry/stop/background subset. Full M06 physical acceptance remains pending.

cases.observed: Start displayed the real SpringBoard microphone permission prompt. Tapping Nicht erlauben produced the permission-specific renderer error, returned Start and left Stop absent.
Novalist microphone switch in Privacy and Security changed from value 0 to 1. After the permission change, the next activate launched a new Novalist process.
After cold launch and reopening the same synthetic scene, Start reached Listening. Permission and generic microphone errors were absent. Stop returned Start and removed Listening/Stop.
Second Start reached Listening. Home then foreground returned Start; Listening/Stop and permission error were absent.

native_path_interpretation: The unmodified mobile shim uses native microphoneStart. Production Swift returns success only after AVAudioSession activation and AVAudioEngine.start; Listening in this UI therefore supports successful simulator native startup, without measuring actual recorded audio.

navigation_attempts.result: Harness navigation failure: iOS Settings search had no Novalist result; subsequent native Privacy navigation succeeded.
Harness locator failure: Mikrofon label included additional text; native MICROPHONE identifier resolved it.
Harness tap hit outer row, leaving toggle value 0; tapping its actual nested switch succeeded in microphone-grant-control.
Harness cold-launch readiness failure before microphone Start; corrected test waited for bookshelf and passed.

limitations: No physical-device acceptance, call interruption, audio-route change, signal-level/audio-quality or transcription claim.
After the iOS permission grant, Novalist required a fresh process; no same-process stale-permission-error clearing claim. The error was absent before and after the successful retry.
No Mac microphone permission was granted or changed. All automation targeted only dedicated simulator iOS UI.
No production instrumentation or source changes. The installed native app hash still equals the fixed lifecycle build, and the synthetic scene remains exactly its original marker.
final_state: Dedicated iPhone simulator has microphone permission enabled; recording stopped and original synthetic scene content preserved.
